logs.summary: Hurricane Polo rapidly intensified into a Category 5 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast, becoming one of the strongest hurricanes ever recorded in the Eastern Pacific. The storm is expected to remain offshore, but officials warn of significant hazards from rainfall and mudslides.
